summary: Iteration 12: Tested Reports branch filter + Suppliers CRUD. 14/14 backend tests PASSED, 12/12 frontend tests PASSED. Both features working correctly end-to-end.

minor.issue: Invalid branch_id (non-ObjectId string) returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400/422. Likely bson.errors.InvalidId not handled in route. Same issue likely affects /api/finance/summary and other endpoints accepting branch_id.

issues: Recharts emits console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. ResponsiveContainer needs explicit minWidth/minHeight or a wrapping element with non-zero size. Cosmetic only - charts still render.
'Desde' and 'Hasta' use native browser date pickers (input type='date') instead of shadcn Calendar component. Inconsistent with the design system used elsewhere.

backend: TestSuppliersCRUD::test_update_supplier (PUT persists changes; unchanged fields intact)
TestSuppliersCRUD::test_delete_supplier_soft_delete (is_active flipped to false; hidden from list)

Open new-supplier dialog and fill all fields incl. category toggle

Search supplier by name returns matching row
Edit supplier opens populated dialog and saves changes
Delete supplier (admin only) - delete button visible, confirm dialog, removed from list

action_items: [MINOR] Wrap ObjectId(branch_id) calls in try/except in /api/reports/sales, /api/finance/summary, /api/reports/dashboard - return 400/422 on InvalidId instead of 500.
[OPTIONAL] Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings on /reports (width=-1, height=-1) by ensuring parent containers have explicit dimensions.

Only 'Sucursal Central' was seeded. Possibly created under a different company (analuhs@gmail.com). Not blocking - features tested with fresh data.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3057 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into routers/<resource>.py modules for maintainability.
ObjectId(branch_id) is called without try/except across many routes (sales, finance, reports, dashboard, stock, etc.) - any malformed ID input causes 500.
Suppliers GET /api/suppliers/{id} does NOT return 404 on soft-deleted suppliers (still returns the doc with is_active=False). Consider filtering or returning 404 to match REST conventions.
Suppliers POST returns only {_id, message} - frontend has to refetch to get the full doc. Consider returning the created supplier object directly for better UX/efficiency.
Login mismatch: review_request lists admin as analuhs@gmail.com/Alta2026$ but /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists admin@cortexia.gt/Demo123!. Latter works; former not validated.

test_credentials.note: Credentials in review_request (analuhs@gmail.com / Alta2026$) were NOT used; documented test_credentials.md credentials were used instead.

rca_of_minor_issue: Invalid branch_id 500: server.py line ~2657 calls ObjectId(branch_id) directly without try/except wrapping. bson.errors.InvalidId is unhandled and bubbles up as 500. Fix: wrap in try/except InvalidId -> raise HTTPException(400, 'branch_id inválido').
